olivia (acme): Hey — we noticed a subtle change after the model bump last night (v1.3 -> v1.4). Our help-center answers have become noticeably shorter and sometimes cut polite closers. Not a full regression but customers notice a different tone.

olivia (acme): Example: before: 
```
Q: How do I reset my password?
A: To reset your password, go to /account/settings > Security and click \"Reset password\". We'll send a link to your email. Let me know if you don't get it and I can help.
```
after: 
```
Q: How do I reset my password?
A: Go to /account/settings > Security and click \"Reset password\".
```

olivia (acme): Small but customer-facing. We started seeing this after the rollout around 11:05 UTC yesterday.

maya (support): Thanks for reporting, @olivia. Can you share the request IDs or a minimal repro call? Also helpful: are you using any custom system prompt or a temperature change?

olivia (acme): Repro curl we ran against Redwood hosted endpoint:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer REDACTED\" \\n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\n  -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-1.4\",\"input\":\"Q: How do I reset my password?\",\"max_tokens\":80,\"temperature\":0.0}'
```
Response (truncated):
```json
{\"id\":\"req_abc123\",\"output\":\"Go to /account/settings > Security and click \\\"Reset password\\\".\"}
```
We have a before-recording (req_xyz789) that used redwood-1.3, same prompt, and that returned the longer answer above.

liam (ml-eng): Noted. Two quick hypotheses: 1) v1.4 has a changed system prompt or safety/conciseness tuning that biases brevity; 2) decoding/penalty defaults changed (e.g., presence/length penalties). Can you run the same call but set \"system_prompt\" explicitly (if you use one) and try temperature 0.2 and also include \"stop\":null? Also include request_id headers if available.

kai (swe): I'll pull the rollout config and compare model build flags. @deploy-bot tag?

deploy-bot: release 1.4 promoted to stable on 2026-02-10T11:05:00Z by ci/cd (hash: f4e8a7). Canary was 2h prior.

maya (support): For now, @olivia can you try one quick A/B: call model redwood-1.4 with an extra system instruction that says \"Be polite and add a short offer to help at the end\" and see if that restores phrasing? If yes, we can push a config workaround while ML team investigates.

olivia (acme): Tried that, adding system: \"You are helpful and include a courteous closing sentence.\" Result: longer answer returned (matches desired tone). So looks like the base behavior changed rather than our prompts being ignored.

liam (ml-eng): Good repro. Please paste the two request_ids (v1.3 and v1.4) and I'll diff model artifacts for the prompt tuning layer. Also will check if any default instruction templates were updated in the release.

sara (support-lead): Escalating to ModelOps and Eng oncall. Tagging priority P2 (customer-facing but not outage). @liam @kai please coordinate. We should compile a short eval set (10-20 customer prompts) for a quick regression test across v1.3/v1.4 and any candidate patch.

liam (ml-eng): Will do — I'll create a quick job to run the eval set and return length / politeness metrics. If it's a tuning artifact we can roll a patch or adjust the system prompt default. ETA 4h.

kai (swe): I found a change in the release notes: default instruction weight decreased in production config (accidental). Pushing a hotfix toggle to re-enable previous instruction_weight. Monitoring logs now.

deploy-bot: config toggle applied to canary and stable.

olivia (acme): Thanks — we'll monitor customer reports. Appreciate the fast triage.

liam (ml-eng): I'll post results of the eval run in this thread when available and link any PRs. Thanks everyone.
